Israeli Air Force is conducting ongoing airstrikes on Nabatieh and Ali Taher in southern Lebanon, with IDF warning northern residents of imminent strikes on the Lebanon front. Iran has acknowledged economic pressures while rejecting Western sanctions' effectiveness in altering Tehran's policies.

sections.executive_summary: Iran announced plans to establish a restricted maritime zone in the Persian Gulf following US naval operations against Iranian oil tankers, with the Secretary of the Supreme National Security Council warning of sanctions on entering vessels. Israeli Air Force is conducting sustained airstrikes on Nabatieh and Ali Taher in southern Lebanon, with IDF operations command warning northern residents of imminent strikes along the Lebanon front. Iranian parliamentary speaker Mohammad Baqer Ghalibaf declared the era of proportional responses has ended, while US Treasury officials assess Iran's remaining oil reserves at approximately 30 million barrels that China has not purchased.

points: Iranian Secretary of Supreme National Security Council Mohammad RezaA'ri announced Iran will declare a restricted maritime zone in the Persian Gulf beginning from areas where the US Navy imposes naval blockade, extending into Gulf waters, with any entering vessel to be added to Iran's sanctions list (Source: @N12chat/225264).

Iranian Revolutionary Guard Navy announced targeting a US remotely operated vessel that intended to enter the 'protected zone' of the Strait of Hormuz, according to a IRGC public relations statement (Source: @VahidOnline/78249).

Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf stated the era of 'proportional responses' has ended, warning that any aggression against Iran's interests and security will receive a faster, heavier, and more painful response (Source: @VahidOnline/78256).

Iranian Economic Minister Ali Madanizadeh stated Tehran's response to US economic pressure is 'economic resistance alongside reforms,' rejecting the notion that sanctions can change Iran's decisions (Source: @VahidOnline/78256).

Ghalibaf acknowledged severe economic challenges including currency volatility, inflation, unemployment, and market management issues that are putting serious pressure on citizens' livelihoods (Source: @VahidOnline/78256).

US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stated the combination of naval blockade and extensive sanctions has severely limited Iran's oil exports and access to revenues, estimating approximately 30 million barrels of Iranian oil remain unpurchased by China (Source: @rodast_omiddana/80403).

A PressTV report cited analysis showing Iran can still transfer billions of dollars annually through accounts linked to US banks despite sanctions designed to completely cut the country from the global financial system (Source: @presstv/205765).

IDF warned residents up to 9km from the northern border that the expanded 'Northern Shield' project is launching, with grant applications opening September 15, 2026 for homeowners to receive up to 182,000 shekels for constructing safe rooms, with 11,000 housing units to receive centralized protection (Source: @almogboker78/18141).

IDF conducted a snap drill launching in early morning hours testing General Staff crisis response, with scenarios including infiltration of 10-15 terrorists from Lebanon, a terror attack on Route 60 in the West Bank, rocket attacks on Tel Aviv, and fighting along the Yellow Line in Gaza (Source: @manniefabian/59109).

Security forces arrested a Hamas terrorist infrastructure of 10 militants in Kfar Akab in the West Bank, uncovering an unlaunched rocket and weapons including M16 rifles and extensive explosives for manufacturing charges (Source: @idf_telegram/25066).
Netanyahu warned that if Iran makes 'a mistake' and attacks Israel, it will receive a blow 'it cannot imagine,' stating the regime's end is approaching (Source: @pkpoi/143866).

IDF Chiefs of Staff test included scenarios of fighting on the Yellow Line spiraling out of control allowing terrorists to breach Israeli territory from Gaza and infiltrate three border communities, with one battalion airlifted from central Israel to Tzeelim training base (Source: @manniefabian/59109).

Gadi Eisenkot's 'Yesh' party announced joining with Hili Tropper, Shira Sapir, Alisifer Peretz, and Shlomi Yehiayav to the Knesset list, with Eisenkot praising the merger as strengthening the 'ethical and qualitative team' (Source: @yediotnews25/134716).

IDF arrested a Hamas terrorist infrastructure of 10 militants in Kfar Akab in West Bank during a joint Shin Bet and IDF operation, uncovering an unlaunched rocket, M16 rifles, and extensive explosives for manufacturing charges (Source: @idf_telegram/25066).

IDF snap drill tested scenarios including fighting along the Yellow Line in the Gaza Strip that spiraled out of control, allowing simulated terrorists to breach Israeli territory from Gaza and infiltrate three border communities (Source: @manniefabian/59109).

One IDF battalion was airlifted by helicopters from central Israel to the Tzeelim training base in the south where troops 'recaptured' one of the communities invaded by simulated terrorists from Gaza during the drill (Source: @manniefabian/59109).

Security forces stated they will continue operating proactively and offensively to thwart terrorism throughout the Judea and Samaria Division to maintain security for residents and Israeli citizens (Source: @idf_telegram/25066).
Israeli Air Force is conducting airstrikes on Nabatieh and Ali Taher in southern Lebanon, with aftermath photos showing destruction in Nabatieh following IAF strikes (Source: @shin_persian/9499).

IDF warned northern residents that in the coming hour a series of combat strikes will occur on the Lebanon front, with explosion sounds audible in Hula Valley, Ramim Ridge, and possibly northern Golan Heights (Source: @New_security8200/203652).

Daily alert data from September 6, 2026 shows 157 total alerts with 62 drones detected, most in Nabatieh al-Fawqa (14 drones), with a 100% targeting ratio from drone strikes (6 out of 6 drone strikes hit targets) (Source: @redlinkleb/41148).

Artillery bombardment reported in 25 locations including al-Mansouri (8), Doha Kfar Rumman (4), Wadi al-Saluki (2), Nabatieh al-Fawqa (2), Itreen (2), al-Dabsha (1), and other villages (Source: @redlinkleb/41148).

Air strikes recorded in 22 locations including Nabatieh al-Fawqa (11), al-Mansouri (3), Nabatieh (2), Arab Salim (2), Kfar Rumman (1), Doha Kfar Rumman (1), and Ali Taher (1) (Source: @redlinkleb/41148).
Most active districts recorded 84 drone photos from Nabatieh and 24 from Jizzin, with casualties reported from strikes in Arab Salman (Source: @redlinkleb/41148).
At least two killed in strikes on Arab Salman as reported by Lebanese Al-Mayadeen channel (Source: @New_security8200/203638).

US State Department spokesperson stated Iraq has embarked on a new path under Prime Minister Zaydi's leadership in full partnership with the United States, supporting his vision for a better future for all Iraqis free from terrorism (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/389317).
Trump stated that oil quantities crossing the Strait of Hormuz have returned to previous levels (Source: @naya_foriraq/89495).
Sentinel-2L satellite images show a new burned area around crude oil storage tanks at Saudi Aramco's Yanbu refinery, a major Red Sea oil export center (Source: @naya_foriraq/89488).

key_developments: Iran announces restricted maritime zone in Persian Gulf from US naval blockade areas, threatening sanctions on vessels - a direct escalation following US attacks on Iranian oil tankers (Source: @N12chat/225264).

Israeli Air Force conducting sustained airstrikes on Nabatieh and Ali Taher in southern Lebanon with IDF warning of imminent strikes on Lebanon front affecting Hula Valley and Ramim Ridge (Source: @shin_persian/9499).

Iranian Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf declares era of proportional responses has ended, warning of faster, heavier, and more painful responses following US naval operations against Iranian tankers (Source: @VahidOnline/78256).

US Treasury estimates only 30 million barrels of Iranian oil remain unpurchased by China, indicating severe impact of naval blockade and sanctions on Iran's oil export capabilities (Source: @rodast_omiddana/80403).

IDF conducted snap drill testing multi-front scenarios including 10-15 terrorist infiltration from Lebanon, West Bank attacks, rocket fire on Tel Aviv, and Gaza Yellow Line fighting (Source: @manniefabian/59109).

Netanyahu warns Iran that any attack will receive a blow 'it cannot imagine,' stating the regime's end is approaching - hardening Israeli stance on Iranian nuclear and regional activities (Source: @pkpoi/143866).

Lebanon reports 62 drones detected with 100% targeting ratio on September 6, 2026, concentrated in Nabatieh region with 22 air strikes and 25 artillery bombardment locations (Source: @redlinkleb/41148).
sections.threat_assessment: The operational tempo between Israel and Lebanon-based actors has significantly increased with sustained IAF strikes on Nabatieh and Ali Taher, while IDF's snap drill demonstrates preparations for simultaneous multi-front crises including Lebanese infiltration, West Bank terrorism, and rocket attacks on Tel Aviv. Iran's announcement of a restricted maritime zone represents a new dimension of confrontation targeting US naval operations, with IRGC Navy claiming successful targeting of a US drone vessel near the Strait of Hormuz. The combination of Iranian threats, Israeli military preparations, and ongoing strikes creates elevated risk of miscalculation.
sections.regional_response: The US has intensified its pressure campaign against Iran through naval operations targeting oil tankers and continued sanctions, with Treasury officials assessing the naval blockade strategy is severely limiting Iran's oil revenues with approximately 30 million barrels remaining unpurchased by China. Iraq appears to be aligning more closely with the US under Prime Minister Zaydi's leadership, with the State Department praising this strategic partnership. The Saudi Aramco Yanbu refinery remains operational as a critical Red Sea export hub despite regional tensions. Ghalibaf's warning about ending proportional responses follows Iran's acknowledgment of severe economic pressures from currency volatility and inflation reaching critical levels.
sections.intelligence_notes: Iran's decision to announce a restricted maritime zone represents a potential game-changer in naval operations, as it formally codifies counter-measures against US blockade enforcement. The IRGC Navy's claim of targeting a US remotely operated vessel near the Strait of Hormuz indicates willingness to engage US maritime assets. Israel's snap drill, which kept most General Staff members unaware and tested operational dilemmas without simulating Iranian ballistic missile attacks, suggests IDF is preparing for limited but complex ground and air scenarios rather than large-scale conventional war. The 100% targeting ratio for drone strikes in Lebanon indicates highly effective intelligence or permissive rules of engagement for strikes following drone detection.
